description: 2-D channel at rest, lower wall no-slip at rest, upper wall impulsively set to U at t=0, periodic in x
reference: Morris, Fox & Zhu, J. Comput. Phys. 136 (1997) 214-226, Sec. V (plane Couette start-up from rest); exact series evaluated in code from u_t = nu u_yy with u(y,0)=0, u(0,t)=0, u(H,t)=U. No number is transcribed from the paper: the paper PDF is paywalled in this work tree and the reference is the closed form the paper itself compares against.
reference_form: u = U y/H + (2U/pi) sum (-1)^n/n sin(n pi y/H) exp(-n^2 pi^2 nu t/H^2); tau_w/(rho nu U/H) = 1 + 2 sum (-1)^n exp(-n^2 pi^2 t*)
